purpose: B0 evidence freeze for the AEP conformance corpus adequacy workstream. The adequacy run measures corpus discrimination against seeded verifier faults; it NEVER modifies the authority chain and never masquerades as a certified-target run.

authority.note: The -03 external run (aps-conformance-suite PR #94) remains immutable historical evidence. The adequacy workstream is NOT a certification and MUST NOT be recorded in certified-target.json.

measured_inputs.note: 32 files on disk = 30 manifest entries + 2 .hex verify keys.

non_invasiveness_contract: The harness writes ONLY inside conformance/aep/adequacy/ (reports) and a temporary directory that is deleted after the run.
Mutants are temporary patched copies generated from declarative find/replace records in faults-v1.json; the in-tree verifiers are never modified.

The harness reads certified-target.json and manifest.json for identity only; a change to either invalidates the freeze (hash mismatch) and the run refuses to start unless --allow-drift is passed and the drift is recorded in the report.
Adequacy results are NEVER promotion evidence: no field of a run may be referenced from certified-target.json, gate-provenance, or publication records.

refreeze_log.reason: B4 additive corpus repair (faults L0-1, L2-7): +invalid-schema/missing-required-field.json, +dsse/tampered-created-at.json. Additive only; prior fixtures untouched. A corpus-change certified-target generation follows the normal trigger policy at the next certification event — this repo edit does not create one.
